statement: X06.P4 closed the get_architecture parity gaps the scout digest names for the baseline's aspect surface (Leiden/Louvain clustering, hotspots, layers, file_tree): a new crates/enforcer-memory/src/analysis/clustering.rs implements deterministic label-propagation community detection over CodeGraph (undirected adjacency built independently of CodeAdjacency, since CodeAdjacency's petgraph fields are private to crate::analysis and this lane's analysis/mod.rs claim was limited to the single `pub mod clustering;` wiring line), and crates/enforcer-memory/src/architecture.rs was extended from the original overview-only shape to the full 12-aspect enum (All/Overview/Structure/Dependencies/Routes/Languages/Packages/EntryPoints/Hotspots/Boundaries/Layers/FileTree/Clusters) behind a new build_report(graph, aspects, path_prefix, hotspot_limit, max_iterations) entry point; build_overview (the original X06.3 function) is kept byte-identical in signature/behavior for existing callers.
why: Louvain/Leiden's modularity-optimization step conventionally relies on a randomized node-visitation order to escape local optima, which conflicts directly with the pack's determinism hard test (same input -> same clusters across 2 runs). Label propagation (Raghavan/Albert/Kumara 2007) is a recognized community-detection algorithm in its own right, not an approximation of Louvain, and gives the determinism contract for free when node visitation is fixed to sorted-id order and every tie-break picks the lexicographically smallest label -- no RNG seed pinning required.
howToApply: Any future caller wanting community/module clustering over CodeGraph should call analysis::clustering::detect_clusters(graph, max_iterations) directly, or get it via architecture::build_report with Aspect::Clusters (also feeds Aspect::Layers, which topologically sorts the returned clusters by inter-cluster dependency direction using Kahn's algorithm, sorted-id tie-breaks, and reports any cycle's cluster ids in LayeringResult::cycle_cluster_ids rather than panicking or silently dropping them). The path_prefix filter on build_report scopes every aspect including clusters/layers by pruning cluster membership post-hoc (filtered_clusters) rather than rebuilding a second CodeGraph, since clustering itself has no filter parameter.
